method: Independent descriptions-only catalog-choice trial; no expected answers supplied.

requests.request: Write a .mts helper whose generic return type preserves the literal keys of its input, and add type-level tests.
One TypeScript library supports two optional browser integrations. Both integrations declare different global $. Design their compiler configuration.
Build the same TypeScript library source for ESM and CommonJS, including declarations. It is a single package.
A worker TypeScript file compiles with document even though that API does not exist there. Audit the environment types.
Our type-check command reports a warm cache hit but newly added .tsx files never get checked. Verify coverage and cache invalidation.
Set up @tsconfig/strictest and Matt Pocock's ts-reset for our application without changing public library consumers.
Propose package layout for a Python-only monorepo. There is no JavaScript or TypeScript code.
Explain escaping $ in a zsh string.
Upgrade our installed Zod dependency from major 3 to major 4 and investigate breaking changes.
Address and resolve the author's existing GitHub pull request review comments, including one about a TypeScript handler.
Fix a TypeScript narrowing error in one function. Keep compiler settings and dependencies unchanged.
Two plain JavaScript scripts overwrite the same runtime global $. Explain their runtime coexistence options; no TypeScript configuration is involved.
